description: Combined vector + graph retrieval over one corpus joined by chunk_id -- search_entities/get_entity/get_neighbors/find_path/get_chunks_for_entity/get_graph_context plus a combined search tool.

outputs.description: Registers a resource + (optionally) an MCP server resource, plus a small inspection asset.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key the in-process HybridKnowledgeSearchResource is registered under.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource under this key.

vector_store.label: Vector Store
vector_store.description: Same fields as knowledge_search_server's KnowledgeSearchResource (provider, connection_string, collection_name [required], api_key_env_var, embed_provider, embed_model, embed_api_key_env_var, text_metadata_key, vector_bucket_name, aws_region, demo_mode).

graph.label: Graph
graph.description: Same fields as knowledge_graph_search_server's KnowledgeGraphSearchResource (provider, path, uri, username_env_var, password_env_var, database, host, port, graph_name).

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Cap on rows returned by any list-returning method.

inspection_asset_name.label: Inspection Asset Name
inspection_asset_name.description: Asset key for the inspection asset reporting this server's configured settings and the corpus-overlap check.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Extra asset tags, applied to the inspection asset.
